text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The team members' abilities were steadily 
growing, but traumatized by their crushing 
defeat against Team First, their 
confidence was slow to return.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
To help them regain their confidence, a 
practice match with Team <First> was arranged.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
This team is undeniably growing stronger. 
However, Little Cocon and the others' 
trust in Acting Director Kashimoto remains 
steadfast as well.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
At any rate, Rice Shower and the others 
tackled their practice with a positive 
mindset, setting their sights on revenge.
